style: Stylized low-poly 3D game asset in a gritty post-soviet Russian courtyard style: chunky slightly exaggerated proportions, bold readable silhouette, clean low-poly faces with hand-painted textures, worn paint, rust and grime, muted greys and browns with a few bright red accents, game-ready, single object centered on its own, no ground, no background.

garage.prompt: A single soviet metal garage box: corrugated steel walls, flat slightly sloped roof, wide rusty double swing door at the front with a padlock, spray-paint graffiti tags on the side walls.

panel_tower.prompt: A tall nine-storey soviet concrete panel residential tower: repeating window grid, glazed balconies of different colors, rooftop elevator box, faded mural stripe on the end wall.

factory_hall.prompt: A small soviet industrial factory hall: brick and concrete walls, sawtooth roof with skylights, one tall brick chimney, big rusty sliding gate, pipes running along the wall.

khrushchevka.prompt: A five-storey soviet panel apartment building (khrushchevka) as one long block: grid of small windows, some lit warm yellow, small balconies with clutter, two entrance doors with concrete canopies, flat roof with antennas.

pipe_bridge.prompt: An overhead industrial pipeline bridge arch: two thick insulated pipes carried high over a road by two steel support frames on both ends, rusty and dented, a red warning band in the middle.

water_tank.prompt: An industrial cylindrical steel water tank on a short concrete base with a ladder, rusty rivets, faded red stripe and pipes coming out at the bottom.

dumpster.prompt: A green soviet metal trash container (dumpster) with dents, rust and a few garbage bags sticking out of the open lid.

street_lamp.prompt: A soviet street lamp: tall tapered concrete pole with a curved metal arm and a cobra-head lamp glowing warm orange.

fence_section.prompt: A modular straight section of an old concrete panel fence with a decorative diamond pattern, cracked, with spray-paint graffiti, ends designed to tile seamlessly.

trash_pile.prompt: A pile of black garbage bags, cardboard boxes, an old tire and a broken chair heaped together on the street.

traffic_cone.prompt: A scuffed orange traffic cone with two reflective white stripes and a square black base.

barrel.prompt: A rusty steel oil barrel with dents and a faded red band, slightly tilted lid.

tire_stack.prompt: A stack of four old worn car tires piled on top of each other, one with a red painted stripe, used as a race track barrier.

billboard.prompt: A roadside billboard on two steel legs with a blank white poster panel, catwalk and two small floodlights on top, rusty frame.

bare_tree.prompt: A bare late-autumn poplar tree with a thick dark trunk, twisted branches and only a few dry brown leaves left.

birch_tree.prompt: An autumn birch tree: white bark with black marks, slightly bent trunk, chunky low-poly clusters of yellow and orange leaves.

bush.prompt: A clump of overgrown courtyard bushes, dark green and yellowing leaves, a crushed plastic bottle inside.

playground.prompt: An old soviet courtyard playground: a metal rocket-shaped climbing frame with a slide, a swing set and a sandbox, peeling red and blue paint.

power_pole.prompt: A wooden electric power pole with a crossbar, glass insulators and a lamp, slightly leaning, wires cut short at both sides.

heating_pipe.prompt: A modular straight segment of an above-ground district heating pipeline: two thick pipes wrapped in torn silver insulation on short concrete supports, ends designed to join seamlessly.

bench.prompt: A soviet courtyard bench with wooden slats on concrete legs and a small metal trash bin next to it, worn paint.

transformer_booth.prompt: A small brick transformer booth with a metal door, a yellow high-voltage warning sign without text, rusty roof edge and graffiti.

tower_crane.prompt: A tall yellow construction tower crane with a lattice mast, long horizontal jib, counterweight and operator cabin, slightly rusty.

old_van.prompt: An old rounded soviet-style minivan (bread loaf shape), faded green paint, rust, one flat tire, no logos.

gazebo.prompt: A small wooden courtyard gazebo with a pointed roof, benches inside, peeling green paint and graffiti.
